## Tidy Flowchart Generator

`flowchart` is an R package for drawing participant flow diagrams
directly from a dataframe using tidyverse. It provides a set of
functions that can be combined with a pipe operator to create all kinds
of flowcharts from a dataframe in an easy way.

You can see the package in action in:
<https://bruigtp.github.io/flowchart/>

## How to install it?

The package is available on CRAN:
<https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/flowchart/index.html>.

``` r
install.packages("flowchart")
```

We can download the development version from the github repository:

``` r
# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github('bruigtp/flowchart')
```

## How it works?

The following GIF provides an example of the tidy process of drawing a
flowchart for a clinical trial:

![animated](https://github.com/bruigtp/flowchart/raw/main/data-raw/flowchart_example.gif)

# Package index

## Creating flowchart

Functions to create a flowchart design

- [`as_fc()`](https://bruigtp.github.io/flowchart/dev/reference/as_fc.md)
  : as_fc
- [`fc_draw()`](https://bruigtp.github.io/flowchart/dev/reference/fc_draw.md)
  : fc_draw
- [`fc_filter()`](https://bruigtp.github.io/flowchart/dev/reference/fc_filter.md)
  : fc_filter
- [`fc_split()`](https://bruigtp.github.io/flowchart/dev/reference/fc_split.md)
  : fc_split

## Customizing flowchart

Function to customize a flowchart

- [`fc_theme()`](https://bruigtp.github.io/flowchart/dev/reference/fc_theme.md)
  : fc_theme
- [`fc_modify()`](https://bruigtp.github.io/flowchart/dev/reference/fc_modify.md)
  : fc_modify

## Combining flowcharts

Functions to combine different flowcharts

- [`fc_merge()`](https://bruigtp.github.io/flowchart/dev/reference/fc_merge.md)
  : fc_merge
- [`fc_stack()`](https://bruigtp.github.io/flowchart/dev/reference/fc_stack.md)
  : fc_stack

## Exporting flowchart

Function to export a flowchart

- [`fc_export()`](https://bruigtp.github.io/flowchart/dev/reference/fc_export.md)
  : fc_export

## View flowchart elements

Function to return \$data or \$fc

- [`fc_view()`](https://bruigtp.github.io/flowchart/dev/reference/fc_view.md)
  : fc_view

## S3 methods for class ‘fc’

Implemented S3 methods (print, summary, plot) for objects of class ‘fc’

- [`print(`*`<fc>`*`)`](https://bruigtp.github.io/flowchart/dev/reference/print.fc.md)
  : print.fc
- [`summary(`*`<fc>`*`)`](https://bruigtp.github.io/flowchart/dev/reference/summary.fc.md)
  : summary.fc
- [`plot(`*`<fc>`*`)`](https://bruigtp.github.io/flowchart/dev/reference/plot.fc.md)
  : plot.fc

## Built-in datasets

Datasets that are included in the package for testing

- [`safo`](https://bruigtp.github.io/flowchart/dev/reference/safo.md) :
  Random generated dataset from the SAFO study
